question:
Ram makes a profit of 30% by selling an article. What would be the profit percent if it were calculated on the selling price instead to the cost price? (Correct to one decimal place)

(CGL 2019 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 23.1%.

100 S.P – 100  C.P = 30 C.P
100 S.P = 130 C.P
CP : SP
10 : 13
Difference between 10 and 13 = 3
Profit on S.P. = \(\frac{3}{13}\) × 100 = 23.1%
question_hi:
राम एक वस्तु को बेचकर 30% लाभ कमाता हैं। यदि क्रय मूल्य के स्थान पर विक्रय मूल्य पर गणना की जाए, तो लाभ प्रतिशत कितना होगा? (दशमलव के एक स्थान तक सही)

(CGL 2019 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात 23.1% है।

100 S.P – 100  C.P = 30 C.P
100 S.P = 130 C.P
CP : SP
10 : 13
10 और 13 के बीच का अंतर = 3
विक्रय मूल्य पर लाभ = \(\frac{3}{13}\) × 100 = 23.1%

question:
An article is sold at a certain price. If it is sold at 70% of this price, then there is a loss of 10%. What is the profit percentage when it is sold at the original selling price?

(CGL 2021 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 200/7%.

Let the CP be 100.

⇒ Original SP = 100

SP at 10% loss = 90

CP : SP
10 : 9
⇒ 9 unit → 70 
⇒ 10 unit (CP) → \(\frac{70}{9}\times10\) = \(\frac{700}{9}\)

New CP : Original SP
   700/9 : 100
           7 : 9
Profit% = \(\frac{2}{7}\times\ 100%\) = \(\frac{\mathbf{200}}{\mathbf{7}}%\)%
question_hi:
एक वस्तु किसी निश्चित कीमत पर बेची जाती है। यदि इसे इस मूल्य के 70% पर बेचा जाता है, तो 10% की हानि होती है। मूल विक्रय मूल्य पर बेचने पर प्रतिशत लाभ क्या है?

(CGL 2021 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात 200/7% है।

मान लीजिए कि CP 100 है।

⇒ मूल SP = 100

10% हानि पर SP = 90

CP : SP
10 : 9
⇒ 9 इकाई → 70

⇒ 10 इकाई (CP) → \(\frac{70}{9}\times10\) = \(\frac{700}{9}\)

नया CP : मूल SP

700/9 : 100

         7 : 9
लाभ% = \(\frac{2}{7}\times\ 100%\) = \(\frac{\mathbf{200}}{\mathbf{7}}%\)%

question:
A sells 12 bicycles at a profit of ₹516 per bicycle and sells 3 bicycles at a loss of ₹129 per bicycle. If the total profit percentage on all the bicycles sold is 15%, the cost price per bicycle is:

(СРО 2018 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. ₹2580.

Profit = 516 × 12 = 6192
Loss = 129 × 3 = 387
Absolute profit on all bicycles = 6192 - 387 = 5805
Profit on per article  = 5805/15 = 387
⇒ 15% = 387
⇒ 100% = ₹2580
question_hi:
एक साइकिल विक्रेता ₹516 प्रति साइकिल के लाभ पर 12 साइकिलें और ₹129 प्रति साइकिल के नुकसान पर 3 साइकिलें बेचता हैं। बिक्री की गई सभी साइकिलों पर यदि कुल लाभ प्रतिशत 15 हैं तो प्रति साइकिल का क्रय मूल्य क्या होगा?

(СРО 2018 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 3 अर्थात ₹2580 है।

लाभ = 516 × 12 = 6192
हानि = 129×3 = 387
सभी साइकिलों पर कुल लाभ = 6192 - 387 = 5805
प्रति वस्तु पर लाभ = 5805/15 = 387
⇒ 15% = 387
⇒ 100% = ₹2580

question:
A grocer purchased 10 kg rice for ₹700. He spends some amount on transportation and then sells it for ₹1,400. If the percentage of profit made by the grocer is 30%, then what is the amount (in ₹) he spends on transportation? (Round off to the nearest integer)

(СРО 2024 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 377.

Let he spend ₹x on transportation.
\(\therefore\) C. P = (700 + x) 
so, \(\left(700+x\right)\times\frac{130}{100}=\ 1400\) 
⇒ \(\left(700\ +\ x\right)\times\frac{13}{10}\) = 1400 
⇒ 700 + x = 1077 
⇒ x = ₹377

(СРО 2024 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 अर्थात 377 है।

मान लीजिए उसने परिवहन पर ₹x खर्च करता है।
\(\therefore\) C. P = (700 + x) 
so, \(\left(700+x\right)\times\frac{130}{100}=\ 1400\) 
⇒ \(\left(700\ +\ x\right)\times\frac{13}{10}\) = 1400 
⇒ 700 + x = 1077 
⇒ x = ₹377

question:
A reduction of 7.5% in the cost price of a commodity enables a shopkeeper to purchase 15 kg more than what he previously purchased for a sum of ₹7,400. In order to make a profit of 32.5% on the pre-reduction cost price of the commodity, at what price (in ₹) per kg should the commodity be sold?

(CPO 2024 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. 53.

Expenditure = Price × Consumption 
∴ P1C1 = P2C2
\(\frac{P_2}{P_1}=\frac{C_1}{C_2}\) 
7.5% =\(\frac{15}{2\ \times\ 100}=\frac{3}{40}\) 
\(\frac{P_2}{P_1}=\frac{C_1}{C_2}=\frac{37}{40}\) 
⇒ 3 → 15kg 
⇒ 1 → 5kg 
∴ 37 → 37 × 5 → 185kg 
40 → 40 × 5 → 200kg
P1 = \(\frac{7400}{185}\) = 40 
S.P = 40 + \(\left(40\ \times\frac{65}{200}\right)\)
S .P = ₹53
question_hi:
किसी वस्तु के लागत मूल्य में 7.5% की कमी होने पर एक दुकानदार ₹7,400 की राशि में पहले खरीदी गई वस्तु से 15 किलोग्राम अधिक वस्तु खरीद सकता है। वस्तु के कटौती-पूर्व लागत मूल्य पर 32.5% का लाभ कमाने के लिए, वस्तु को प्रति किलोग्राम किस मूल्य (₹ में) पर बेचा जाना चाहिए?

(CPO 2024 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 अर्थात 53 है।

खर्च = मूल्य × उपभोग

∴ P1C1 = P2C2
\(\frac{P_2}{P_1}=\frac{C_1}{C_2}\) 
7.5% =\(\frac{15}{2\ \times\ 100}=\frac{3}{40}\) 
\(\frac{P_2}{P_1}=\frac{C_1}{C_2}=\frac{37}{40}\) 
⇒ 3 → 15 किग्रा 
⇒ 1 → 5 किग्रा 
∴ 37 → 37 × 5 → 185 किग्रा 
40 → 40 × 5 → 200 किग्रा
P1 = \(\frac{7400}{185}\) = 40 
विक्रय मूल्य = 40 + \(\left(40\ \times\frac{65}{200}\right)\)
विक्रय मूल्य = ₹53

question:
By selling an article for ₹131.25, a trader gains as much percent as the number representing the cost price of the article. In order to earn 40% profit, at what price (in ₹) should he sell the article?

(CGL 2020 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. 105.

SP = 131.25 
Let CP = x 
x + \(\frac{x\times x}{100}\) = 131.25

x2 + 175x – 75x – 13125 = 0 
x(x + 175) – 75(x + 175) = 0 
x = 75, – 175
∴. CP = 75
New SP = 75 × \(\frac{140}{100}\) = ₹105

(CGL 2020 Pre)
solution_hi:

विक्रय मूल्य = 131.25
माना क्रय मूल्य = x 

x + \(\frac{x\times x}{100}\) = 131.25 
x2 + 100x – 13125 = 0 
x2 + 175x – 75x – 13125 = 0 
x(x + 175) – 75(x + 175) = 0 
x = 75, – 175
∴. क्रय मूल्य = 75
नया विक्रय मूल्य = 75 × \(\frac{140}{100}\) = ₹105

question:
In a certain shop, the profit is 130% of the cost price. If the cost price increases by 28% and the selling price remains constant, then what is the profit percentage to the nearest whole number? 

(CGL 2022 Pre)
solution:
The correct answer is option 4 i.e. 80%.

\(\frac{Profit}{CP}=\frac{130}{100}\)
SP - CP = Profit
SP = Profit + CP
SP = 100 + 130 = 230

New profit% = \(\frac{102}{128}\) × 100%
⇒ 79.69% ≈ 80%
question_hi:

(CGL 2022 Pre)
solution_hi:
सही उत्तर विकल्प 4 अर्थात 80% है।

लाभ/क्रय मूल्य \(=\frac{130}{100}\) 
SP - CP = लाभ
SP = लाभ + CP
SP = 100 + 130 = 230

नया लाभ % = \(\frac{102}{128}\) × 100%
⇒ 79.69% ≈ 80%

question:
A shopkeeper is incurring a loss of cost price of 4 pens while selling 20 pens to Ajay. If the shopkeeper had purchased 20 pens at 10% less price and had sold 20 pens to Ajay at 25% more than the selling price, then how much percentage would he have gained (rounded off to 1 decimal place)?

SP 2023 Phase-11 Graduation L.
solution:

⇒ CP. of 16 pens = SP of 20 pens

Percentage profit = \(\frac{50}{450}\) × 100%= 11.1%

प्रतिशत लाभ = \(\frac{50}{450}\) × 100%= 11.1%
